h: First Lady Remi Tinubu says she wants to leave Aso Rock in 2031
p: Nigeria's First Lady Remi Tinubu has reportedly said she hopes to leave the presidential villa in 2031 for a Nigeria she can enjoy. The remark, made as the 2027 campaign gets under way, is drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Supporters read it as confidence in a second term for her husband.
Opposition voices say Nigerians want results, not predictions.
